messages:
auditor_jane: Hi team — in the auditor packet we noted an RBAC change that granted `svc-data-processor` cluster role on 2025-02-18. Can you provide evidence of the change (PR, approver, and audit events) plus KMS key rotation proof and the incident triage doc referenced (CVE-2025-0812)? Need this mapped to SOC2 CC6 and ISO A.9 controls. Last 6 months of logs preferred.
emily: Hey Jane — yes, we can. I'll assemble PR/approvals + CloudTrail events + KMS rotation artifacts. Quick Q: do you need full raw logs or redacted/sanitized copies for PII? :thinking_face:
auditor_jane: Full raw logs preferred, but if PII blocks sharing we can accept sanitized with a manifest and hashes. Also need to know who initiated the key rotation and the approved change ticket number.
ben: FYI rotation was initiated as part of scheduled rotation job but the manual force-rotate happened 2025-02-12 by `svc-ops` user. Approver ticket was ITOPS-7943. I'll export the KMS rotation history and policy. Example API we used:
```
aws kms get-key-rotation-status --key-id alias/rdw-prod-root
aws kms list-key-versions --key-id 1234abcd-12ab-34cd-56ef-1234567890ab
```
raj: RBAC change PR is here: https://git.company/repo/pulls/4312 — approved by @sara on 2025-02-18. Kubernetes diff (excerpt):
```
- kind: RoleBinding
  metadata:
    name: svc-data-processor-binding
  subjects:
-   kind: ServiceAccount
    name: svc-data-processor
    namespace: data
  roleRef:
    kind: ClusterRole
    name: svc-data-processor
```
raj: And the k8s audit event we retained (kubectl output snippet):
```
$ kubectl get events --field-selector involvedObject.name=svc-data-processor -n data -o json | jq '.items[] | {timestamp:.lastTimestamp, actor:.user.username, verb:.verb, obj:.involvedObject.name}'
{"timestamp":"2025-02-18T14:12:03Z","actor":"github-app[ci-bot]","verb":"patch","obj":"svc-data-processor"}
{"timestamp":"2025-02-18T14:12:10Z","actor":"sara@redwood.com","verb":"approve","obj":"svc-data-processor"}
```
deploy-bot: export complete: s3://redwood-evidence/collections/2025-02-18/2432104567/export-v1.tar.gz (contains PR.pdf, approver-emails.eml, k8s-audit.ndjson, cloudtrail-events.ndjson, kms-rotation-manifest.json)
emily: Uploaded sanitized and raw copies. Bucket layout:
- s3://redwood-evidence/iso/soc2/2025/2432104567/pr-4312.pdf
- s3://redwood-evidence/iso/soc2/2025/2432104567/approver-sara.eml
- s3://redwood-evidence/iso/soc2/2025/2432104567/k8s-audit-2025-02-18.ndjson
- s3://redwood-evidence/iso/soc2/2025/2432104567/cloudtrail-kms-rotations.ndjson.gz
- s3://redwood-evidence/iso/soc2/2025/2432104567/kms-rotation-manifest.json
- s3://redwood-evidence/iso/soc2/2025/2432104567/incident-CVE-2025-0812-triage.pdf
- s3://redwood-evidence/iso/soc2/2025/2432104567/manifest-hashes.txt
ben: Added control mapping CSV: s3://redwood-evidence/iso/soc2/2025/2432104567/control-map-cc6-a9.csv — maps artifacts to SOC2 CC6, CC7 and ISO A.9. Included `who`, `what`, `when`, `evidence_path` columns.
emily: Note on retention: CloudTrail (prod) retention is 5 years in prod-audit index; KMS key usage audit logs are archived to Glacier with 7-year retention for keys with PD data. We exported the archived object metadata (glacier retrieval id included in kms-rotation-manifest.json).
auditor_jane: Can you also provide the CloudTrail query you used so we can reproduce events? ben: sure. Example CloudTrail query (CloudWatch Logs Insights):
```
fields @timestamp, @message
| filter eventSource = "kms.amazonaws.com" and eventName in ["EnableKeyRotation", "RotateKey"]
| filter requestParameters.keyId = "arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:111122223333:key/1234abcd-12ab-34cd-56ef-1234567890ab"
| sort @timestamp desc
```
emily: For the incident triage doc (CVE-2025-0812) we included timeline, root cause (vuln in third-party dep), mitigation steps, deploy rollback, and follow-up vuln-scan results. Postmortem link: s3://redwood-evidence/incidents/2025/CVE-2025-0812/postmortem.pdf
auditor_jane: Two small asks before I close this out: 1) need the signed rotation approval (email chain or ticket sign-off) 2) confirm sanitized artifacts have hash manifest so we can verify integrity after download.
emily: Signed ticket snapshot and approver email uploaded as `approver-sara-signed.pdf`. Hash manifest present at `manifest-hashes.txt` and we provided SHA256 sums. All sanitized files are suffixed `-sanitized` as requested.
auditor_jane: Perfect, thanks. I'll pull the bucket, validate hashes, and reach back if anything missing. Appreciate the quick turnaround :thumbsup:
ben: If you want, I can run an ad-hoc export with PII redaction steps documented and produce a short checklist for the evidence package. raj: +1 — happy to help with any additional k8s audit slices.
emily: OK tagging this as delivered. Follow-up items: convert export to auditor package and send transfer SR. Closing here unless you need more. :)
